roles_en: Minister of war of the Republic of Armenia
bio_am: Ծնած է Իգդիր։ Նակաշիձէի (1905) եւ Ալիխանովի (1907) ահաբեկիչը, Բաշ-Ապարանի հերոսը (1918), մահացած է 1956-ին։
bio_en: Drastamat Kanayan, known as Dro, was born in Igdir in the Surmalu district of the Ararat plain into a well-off family, studied at the Russian gymnasium in Yerevan and in 1904 entered military service to train as an officer. After the Baku massacre of February 1905 he killed the Baku governor Nakashidze with a bomb in May 1905, fought in the 1905-06 self-defence under Nikol Duman and Murad of Sebastia and alongside Keri in Nakhichevan and Zangezur, and in 1907 assassinated General Alikhanov in Alexandropol. In the First World War he commanded an Armenian volunteer regiment, and in May 1918 he led the victorious defence at Bash-Abaran; he later served the Republic of Armenia as a commander and minister. He lived in exile after Sovietisation and died in Boston in March 1956, where his body lay in state at the Hairenik hall.
